note: Campaign 1 of #4966 — the introduction and development of yoga in English print, 1850–1930. Curated by ia-campaign-curate.mjs on 2026-09-21 from q1-yoga.json, q2-patanjali.json, q3-authors.json; config yoga-west.json. Every id probed against archive.org/metadata: not access-restricted, not lending, page images present (jp2), imprint ≤ 1930. One scan per work; alternates listed per book. REVIEW:no year rows — confirm the imprint on the title page before --commit. Hand-pruned 2026-09-21 from 119 curated picks to one scan per WORK (the curator clusters by surname, so a work catalogued once under Patañjali and once under its translator splits): 28 dropped, listed in `hand_pruned`. The 103 Digital Library of India picks sit in the separate review manifest (manifests/yoga-west-2026-09-21-review.json) — imprint years there are often the author birth year and several are Bengali despite the English tag; each needs a title-page look before import.
